strategy.summary: TestForge's axe scan found `/` and `/contact` free of violations at any impact, and no e2e test checks them with axe. Add an axe check (AxeBuilder from the already-installed @axe-core/playwright) as a new test in the existing spec for each page, after the page has loaded, failing on any violation of impact minor or worse and naming each rule, its impact and its elements. Known violations on /about and /cart are left alone; existing tests are unchanged.
inScope: a small shared helper (tests/support/axe.js) that runs axe and returns the violations at the guarded impacts, used by both specs
outOfScope: Known violations color-contrast on /about and image-alt on /cart (earlier runs reported them; a person's to fix)
Keyboard and screen-reader behaviour, which axe cannot detect
assumptions: The app is served by the repo's own webServer (node server.js on port 4174) as the existing specs do; nothing is faked.
Impacts guarded are minor, moderate, serious and critical (the work item reports minor or worse), so no rule or region is excluded.
Existing tests stay unchanged; the axe checks are new tests in the same files.

risks.description: Axe runs before the page content renders and passes on an empty page
risks.mitigation: Each check first asserts a visible element of the loaded page (the 'Corner Shop' heading on /, the 'Send' button on /contact) before analysing.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The home page `/` has no axe violation of impact minor or worse, checked by an e2e test.
The contact page `/contact` has no axe violation of impact minor or worse, checked by an e2e test.

candidates.text: The axe_checks gate in self_check only counts a page as guarded when the spec that opens it calls `new AxeBuilder({ page }).analyze()` itself; running AxeBuilder inside a shared helper module isn't recognised. Keep AxeBuilder in the spec and share only the impact filtering (tests/support/axe.js guardedViolations).
candidates.evidence: GAPS-20261122-0C4F: self_check flagged / and /contact while AxeBuilder ran in tests/support/axe.js; ready once each spec called AxeBuilder directly.
